en.s: The siege of Ctesiphon took place on 27 April 629 between the forces of Shahrbaraz and Ardashir III. Shahrbaraz managed to capture Ctesiphon with a small force, revealing to all the weakness of the Sasanian Empire.

zh.s: 629年4月27日，沙赫尔巴拉兹与阿尔达希尔三世的军队围攻泰西封。沙赫尔巴拉兹以少量兵力攻占泰西封，向各方暴露了萨珊帝国的弱点。

en.s: The Battle of Sétif (Arabic: معركة سطيف) took place on April 27, 1153, AD, in the region of Sétif in present-day Algeria. it was a battle between a coalition of Arab tribes and the Almohads led by the caliph Abd al-Mu'min. The result of the battle was a victory for the Almohads.

zh.s: 公元1153年4月27日，今阿尔及利亚塞提夫地区爆发塞提夫战役。交战双方是由哈里发阿卜杜勒·穆明领导的阿尔摩哈德王朝军队与阿拉伯部落联盟。阿尔摩哈德王朝获胜。

en.s: The battle of Schosshalde was fought between the imperial city of Bern and the House of Habsburg on 27 April 1289 just outside Bern (between Bern and Ostermundigen). The background of the conflict is Bern's refusal to pay taxes to Habsburg, and turning to the anti-Habsburg alliance of Burgundy and Savoy for protection. Burgundy declared war on Habsburg in 1287, and Rudolf of Habsburg treated Bern as a Burgundian city, laying siege to it twice without success.The son of Rudolf of Habsubrg, duke Rudolf of Swabia moved towards Bern with 300 cavalry in April 1289 and prepared an ambush outside of the city while harassing the landscape in an attempt to draw out a sortie.

zh.s: 1289年4月27日，伯尔尼城外（伯尔尼与奥斯特蒙迪根之间）爆发绍斯沙尔德战役，交战双方是伯尔尼帝国自由市和哈布斯堡王朝。冲突起因是伯尔尼拒绝向哈布斯堡缴税，并转而寻求勃艮第和萨伏依反哈布斯堡联盟的保护。勃艮第于1287年向哈布斯堡宣战，哈布斯堡的鲁道夫一世则把伯尔尼视为勃艮第的城市，曾两度围攻但都未能攻下。鲁道夫之子、施瓦本公爵鲁道夫于1289年4月率300名骑兵向伯尔尼进发，并在城外设伏，同时袭扰周边地区，试图引诱城内守军出击。

en.s: The Battle of Dunbar was the only significant field action of the campaign of 1296 during the beginning of the First War of Scottish Independence.

zh.s: 1296年战役期间，邓巴战役是第一次苏格兰独立战争初期唯一一场重要的野战。

en.s: The Battle of Hořice (German name: Horschitz) was fought on April 27, 1423 between the Orebites faction of the Hussites and Bohemian catholics. The Hussites were led by Jan Žižka (who was completely blind at the time of the battle), while the catholics were led by multiple convertite Čeněk of Wartenberg. The battle took place on the Gothard plateau near Hořice. Thanks to strategic position which allowed perfect use of Hussite war wagons and Žižka's tacticall skills, Hussites eventually won this battle. Hussites took the high ground and built their Wagenburg (wagon fort) there.

zh.s: 霍日采战役于1423年4月27日爆发，交战双方是胡斯派奥雷比派与波希米亚天主教徒。胡斯派由扬·杰式卡率领，当时他已完全失明；天主教一方由屡次改宗的切涅克·冯·瓦尔滕贝格率领。战役发生在霍日采附近的戈特哈德高地。胡斯派利用有利地势和战车堡垒，凭借杰式卡的战术最终获胜。他们占据高地，并在那里建起车阵堡垒（Wagenburg）。

en.s: The Battle of Mactan (Cebuano: Gubat sa Mactan; Tagalog: Labanan sa Mactan; Spanish: Batalla de Mactán) was fought in the Philippines on 27 April 1521, prior to Spanish colonization. The warriors of Lapu-Lapu, a native chieftain of Mactan Island, overpowered and defeated a Spanish force fighting for Rajah Humabon of Cebu, under the command of Ferdinand Magellan, who was killed in the battle.

zh.s: 1521年4月27日，西班牙殖民统治建立前，菲律宾爆发麦克坦岛战役。麦克坦岛当地首领拉普拉普率领的战士击败了费迪南·麦哲伦指挥的西班牙军队；这支西班牙军队支持宿务的拉贾·胡马邦。麦哲伦在战斗中阵亡。

en.s: The Battle of Bicocca or La Bicocca (Italian: Battaglia della Bicocca) was fought on 27 April 1522, during the Italian War of 1521–26. A combined French and Venetian force under Odet de Foix, Vicomte de Lautrec, was decisively defeated by a Imperial–Spanish and Papal army under the overall command of Prospero Colonna. Lautrec then withdrew from Lombardy, leaving the Duchy of Milan in Imperial hands. Having been driven from Milan by an Imperial advance in late 1521, Lautrec had regrouped, attempting to strike at Colonna's lines of communication.

zh.s: 1522年4月27日，意大利战争（1521—1526年）期间，比科卡战役爆发。奥代·德·富瓦、洛特雷克子爵率领的法威联军，被普罗斯佩罗·科隆纳统率的帝国、西班牙和教皇联军决定性击败。洛特雷克随后撤出伦巴第，让米兰公国落入帝国之手。1521年末，洛特雷克在帝国军推进后被迫撤出米兰，之后重新集结，试图袭击科隆纳的交通线。

en.s: The Battle of Mingolsheim (German: Schlacht bei Mingolsheim) was fought on 27 April 1622, near the German village of Wiesloch, 23 km (14 mi) south of Heidelberg (and 8 km or 5 mi south of Wiesloch), between a Protestant army under General von Mansfeld, Hans Michael Elias von Obentraut, and the Margrave of Baden-Durlach against a Roman Catholic army under Count Tilly.

zh.s: 明戈尔斯海姆战役（德语：Schlacht bei Mingolsheim）于1622年4月27日在德国村庄维斯洛赫附近发生，地点位于海德堡以南23公里（14英里），也就是维斯洛赫以南8公里（5英里）。交战双方是曼斯费尔德将军、汉斯·米夏埃尔·埃利亚斯·冯·奥本特劳特和巴登-杜拉赫藩侯率领的新教军队，以及蒂利伯爵率领的罗马天主教军队。

en.s: The Battle of Carbisdale (also known as Invercarron) took place close to the Village of Culrain on 27 April 1650 and was part of the Wars of the Three Kingdoms. It was fought by the Royalist leader James Graham, 1st Marquess of Montrose, against the Scottish Government of the time, dominated by Archibald Campbell, 1st Marquess of Argyll and a grouping of radical Covenanters, known as the Kirk Party. The battlefield has been inventoried and protected by Historic Scotland under the Scottish Historical Environment Policy of 2009.

zh.s: 卡比斯代尔战役又称因弗卡伦战役，1650年4月27日在英国库尔兰村附近爆发，是三国之战的一部分。保王党领袖、第一代蒙特罗斯侯爵詹姆斯·格雷厄姆与当时的苏格兰政府交战。政府由第一代阿盖尔侯爵阿奇博尔德·坎贝尔主导，并有激进的圣约派团体“教会派”参与。苏格兰历史保护机构依据2009年政策，将战场列入清查并予以保护。

en.s: The Battle of Hutong was a military conflict between the Tsardom of Russia and the Qing dynasty which occurred in the spring of 1654 on the Songhua River. Korean musketeers were also present from Joseon. It resulted in the retreat of Russian forces.

zh.s: 胡同战役是俄罗斯沙皇国与清朝之间的一场军事冲突，于1654年春在松花江上发生。朝鲜王朝也派出了火枪手参战。战斗以俄军撤退告终。

en.s: The Siege of Barcelona took place between 3 and 27 April 1706 during the War of the Spanish Succession when a Franco-Spanish army led by Philip V laid siege to Barcelona in an attempt to recapture it following its fall to an English-led Allied army the previous year. The siege was abandoned, following the appearance of a large English fleet under the command of John Leake carrying reinforcements. The Franco-Spanish army was forced to abandon its supplies and artillery in its hasty retreat. Phillip was cut off from returning to Madrid, and so he crossed into France.

zh.s: 1706年4月3日至27日，西班牙王位继承战争期间，菲利普五世率领法西联军围攻巴塞罗那，试图夺回这座前一年被英国领导的联军攻占的城市。约翰·利克率领的大批英国舰队携援军抵达后，围城被迫中止。法西联军仓促撤退，丢弃了补给和火炮。菲利普被切断了返回马德里的道路，于是转道进入法国。

en.s: The siege of Villafranca took place between 14 and 27 April 1744, during the War of the Austrian Succession. The armies of Spain and France advancing towards the Kingdom of Sardinia and attacked the entrenched positions in the Villafranca pass, defended by Anglo-Sardinian forces. The Franco-Spanish attacks were not very successful, but the defenders, due to the high losses suffered during the attacks, were forced to abandon the port of Villafranca with a large part of their forces.

zh.s: 1744年4月14日至27日，奥地利王位继承战争期间，西班牙和法国军队向撒丁王国推进，并进攻维拉弗兰卡隘口的坚固阵地。守军由英撒联军组成。法西联军的进攻成效不大，但守军在战斗中伤亡惨重，被迫率大部分兵力撤离维拉弗兰卡港。

en.s: Pontiac's War (also known as Pontiac's Conspiracy or Pontiac's Rebellion) was launched in 1763 by a confederation of Native Americans who were dissatisfied with British rule in the Great Lakes region following the French and Indian War (1754–1763). Warriors from numerous nations joined in an effort to drive British soldiers and settlers out of the region.

zh.s: 庞蒂亚克战争又称庞蒂亚克阴谋或庞蒂亚克叛乱，于1763年爆发。参加起义的北美原住民部族联盟不满英国在法国—印第安战争（1754—1763年）后统治五大湖地区。多个部族的战士联合起来，试图将英国士兵和定居者赶出该地区。

en.s: The action at Osborne's (sometimes spelled Osburn's or Osborns), Virginia was a minor naval–land engagement on April 27, 1781, in the James River during the American Revolutionary War. The battle resulted in the near-complete destruction of the Virginia State Navy as well as a large stockpile of Virginian tobacco (in use as a currency at the time).

zh.s: 1781年4月27日，美国独立战争期间，弗吉尼亚州詹姆斯河上的奥斯本庄园发生了一场小规模海陆交战。战斗几乎摧毁了整个弗吉尼亚州海军，并使大量弗吉尼亚烟草被毁；当时烟草被用作货币。该地点有时也拼作Osburn’s或Osborns。

en.t: 1790–91 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1790–91 United States House of Representatives elections were held on various dates in various states between April 27, 1790, and October 11, 1791. Each state set its own date for its elections to the House of Representatives before or after the first session of the 2nd United States Congress convened on October 24, 1791. This was the first midterm election cycle, which took place in the middle of President George Washington's first term.

zh.s: 1790年至1791年，美国各州在不同日期举行众议院选举，时间从1790年4月27日至1791年10月11日不等。各州自行决定选举日期，可以安排在第二届美国国会于1791年10月24日召开首次会议之前或之后。这是美国首次中期选举周期，选举在乔治·华盛顿总统第一任期中举行。

en.s: The Battle of Revolax (Finnish: Revonlahden taistelu) took place on 27 April 1808 at Revonlahti, (now part of Siikajoki) in Northern Ostrobothnia, Finland, when the Swedish supreme commander Wilhelm Mauritz Klingspor and the Savolax brigade under Colonel Johan Adam Cronstedt, a total of about 2,250 Swedes surprised an isolated Russian column of about 1,700 men under Major General Michail Leontievich Bulatov. The Russians were surrounded and tried to cut their way through but failed and the Russian general Bulatov was taken prisoner by the Swedes. This, and the preceding battle of Siikajoki nine days earlier, are considered very important events since they are the first Swedish victories after about 2 months of planned retreat.

zh.s: 1808年4月27日，芬兰北博滕区雷沃拉赫蒂（现属锡卡约基）爆发雷沃拉克斯战役。瑞典最高统帅威廉·莫里茨·克林斯波尔与约翰·亚当·克龙施泰特上校率领的萨沃拉克斯旅共约2,250人，突袭了米哈伊尔·列昂季耶维奇·布拉托夫少将率领的一支约1,700人的孤立俄军纵队。俄军被包围后试图突围，但没有成功，布拉托夫也被瑞典军俘虏。此前九天发生的锡卡约基战役与此战都十分重要，因为它们是瑞典军在计划撤退约两个月后取得的首批胜利。

en.s: The Battle of York was fought on April 27, 1813, in York (present-day Toronto), the capital of the province of Upper Canada (present-day Ontario), during the Anglo-American War of 1812. An American force supported by a naval flotilla landed on the lake shore to the west and advanced against the town, which was defended by an outnumbered force of regulars, militia and Ojibway natives under the overall command of Major General Roger Hale Sheaffe, the Lieutenant Governor of Upper Canada. Sheaffe's forces were defeated and Sheaffe retreated with his surviving regulars to Kingston, abandoning the militia and civilians.

zh.s: 1813年4月27日，1812年英美战争期间，双方在约克（今多伦多）交战。当时约克是上加拿大省的首府（今属安大略省）。美国军队在舰队支援下从西侧湖岸登陆，向镇内推进。守军人数较少，由正规军、民兵和奥吉布瓦原住民组成，整体由上加拿大副总督罗杰·黑尔·谢弗少将指挥。谢弗的部队被击败，他带领幸存正规军撤往金斯顿，留下民兵和平民。

en.s: The Battle of Yerbas Buenas developed during the Chilean War of Independence on April 27, 1813. It is also known as the Surprise of Yerbas Buenas. In the battle, the Chilean forces, under the command of Colonel Juan de Dios Puga, and the Spanish forces, under the command of Bridgadier Antonio Pareja, confronted each other. The battle began when, in the middle of the night, the Chileans let loose on the Spanish soldiers that were camping in the village of Yerbas Buenas, near Linares.

zh.s: 1813年4月27日，智利独立战争期间发生耶尔巴斯·布埃纳斯战役，又称耶尔巴斯·布埃纳斯突袭。由胡安·德·迪奥斯·普加上校指挥的智利军与安东尼奥·帕雷哈准将指挥的西班牙军交战。战斗在深夜打响，智利军突然袭击了驻扎在耶尔巴斯·布埃纳斯村的西班牙士兵。该村位于利纳雷斯附近。

en.s: Elections were held in the colony of Queensland between 27 April 1860 to 11 May 1860 to elect all 26 members of the colony's Legislative Assembly. It was conducted in nine single-member constituencies, four two-member constituencies, and three three-member constituencies, all with a first past the post system. Suffrage was limited to men who owned property. The electorates were also malapportioned to favour pastoral districts.

zh.s: 1860年4月27日至5月11日，昆士兰殖民地举行选举，选出立法议会全部26名议员。选举划分为9个单席选区、4个双席选区和3个三席选区，均采用简单多数制。只有拥有财产的男性有投票权。选区划分还偏袒牧业地区，造成选票权重不均。

en.s: The April Revolution, also known as the Yellow Revolution, was a successful campaign initiated by Antonio Guzmán Blanco with former leaders of the Venezuelan Federal War (1859-1863), including his most adept followers, Joaquín Crespo and Francisco Linares Alcántara, to overthrow the Blue government of José Ruperto Monagas.

zh.s: 委内瑞拉四月革命又称黄革命，是安东尼奥·古斯曼·布兰科发起的一场成功运动，参与者包括委内瑞拉联邦战争（1859—1863年）的前领导人，以及他最得力的追随者华金·克雷斯波和弗朗西斯科·利纳雷斯·阿尔坎塔拉。此次运动旨在推翻何塞·鲁佩托·莫纳加斯领导的蓝党政府。

en.s: The Anglo-Manipur War or Manipuri Rebellion of 1891 was a short armed conflict between the British Colonial Forces and the royal princes of the Manipur Kingdom. The conflict began with a palace coup staged by the general (Senapati) of Manipur, ousting its reigning king, and installing a half-brother, the heir-apparent, in his place. The British government took objection to the action and attempted to arrest the general.

zh.s: 1891年英帕尔战争又称曼尼普尔叛乱，是英国殖民军与曼尼普尔王国王子之间的一场短暂武装冲突。曼尼普尔军方首领（塞纳帕蒂）发动宫廷政变，推翻在位国王，改立其同父异母弟弟、王位继承人。英国政府反对此举，并试图逮捕这名将领。

en.s: The 1895 World Championship was a football match that took place at Tynecastle Park on 27 April 1895 between the winner of the English Football League First Division, Sunderland, and Scottish League Division One, Heart of Midlothian. The match was won by Sunderland 5–3.

en.s: The 1908 Summer Olympics (officially the Games of the IV Olympiad and also known as London 1908) were an international multi-sport event held in London, United Kingdom, from 27 April to 31 October 1908. The 1908 Games were relocated to London after Italy withdrew from hosting on financial grounds.

en.s: The Second Guangzhou Uprising, known in Chinese as the Yellow Flower Mound Uprising or the Guangzhou Xinhai Uprising, was a failed uprising that took place in China. It was led by Huang Xing and his fellow revolutionaries against the Qing dynasty in Canton (Guangzhou). It is honored in Guangzhou's Yellow Flower Mound or Huanghuagang Park.

zh.s: 第二次广州起义又称黄花岗起义或广州辛亥起义，是中国发生的一场失败起义。起义由黄兴及其革命同志领导，反抗清朝统治，地点在广州。广州人将起义者纪念在黄花岗（黄花岗公园）。

en.s: Elections were held in the Australian state of Queensland on 27 April 1912 to elect the 72 members of the state's Legislative Assembly. The election was the first for the recently formed Liberal government of Digby Denham, who had been premier since 7 February 1911. The opposition Labor Party was led by David Bowman, who had been Labor leader since 15 April 1907.

en.t: 1940 Mandatory Palestine v Lebanon football match

en.s: The 1946 FA Cup final was the 65th final of the FA Cup, and the first after World War II. en.s: The history of Derby County Football Club from 1884 to 1967 covers the major events in the history of the club from its formation in 1884 until the end of the 1966–1967 season. en.s: Operation Moolah was a United States Air Force (USAF) effort during the Korean War to obtain through defection a fully capable MiG-15 jet fighter, which was at the time the Soviet Union's best fighter. Communist forces introduced the MiG-15 to Korea on November 1, 1950. USAF pilots reported that the performance of the MiG-15 was superior to that of United Nations aircraft, including the USAF's new F-86 Sabre.

en.t: South Carolina's 1st congressional district special election, 1971
en.s: The 1971 South Carolina 1st congressional district special election was held on April 27, 1971 to select a Representative for the 1st congressional district to serve out the remainder of the term for the 92nd Congress. The special election resulted from the death of longtime Representative L. Mendel Rivers on December 28, 1970. Mendel Jackson Davis, a former aide to Rivers and his godson, won a surprising victory in the Democratic primary and went on to win the general election against Republican challenger James B. Edwards.

en.s: The Saur Revolution (Dari: إنقلاب ثور Pashto: د ثور انقلاب‎) (also Sawr Revolution) was a revolution led by the People's Democratic Party of Afghanistan (PDPA) against the rule of self-proclaimed Afghan President Mohammed Daoud Khan on 27–28 April 1978. The government at the time was led by Daoud, who had previously overthrown his cousin King Mohammed Zahir in 1973. 'Saur' is the Dari name of the second month of the Persian calendar, the month in which the uprising took place. The revolution led to the 1979 intervention by the Soviets and the 1979–1989 Soviet–Afghan War against the Mujahideen.

zh.s: 四月革命（达里语：إنقلاب ثور；普什图语：د ثور انقلاب‎），又称“萨乌尔革命”，是阿富汗人民民主党于1978年4月27日至28日发动的一场革命，目标是推翻自称总统的穆罕默德·达乌德汗。当时由达乌德执政；他此前于1973年推翻了自己的堂兄、国王穆罕默德·查希尔。萨乌尔是波斯历第二个月的达里语名称，起义就发生在该月。这场革命促成了1979年苏联介入，以及1979年至1989年苏联—阿富汗战争中苏联对抗圣战者的局面。

en.s: General elections were held in South Africa on 27 April 1994. The elections were the first in which citizens of all races were allowed to take part, and were therefore also the first held with universal adult suffrage. The election was conducted under the direction of the Independent Electoral Commission (IEC), and marked the culmination of the four-year process that ended apartheid. Millions queued in lines over a three-day voting period. Altogether 19,726,579 votes were counted and 193,081 were rejected as invalid.
en.n: This entry records the first universal-suffrage election commemorated on 27 April 1994; voting extended across several days.

zh.s: 南非于1994年4月27日举行大选，这是首次允许所有种族公民参加的选举，也是该国首次实行普遍成年公民选举权。选举由独立选举委员会（IEC）组织，标志着持续四年的废除种族隔离进程告一段落。投票持续三天，数百万人排队投票。共计19,726,579张选票，其中193,081张被判无效。

en.s: Apartheid ( ə-PART-(h)yte, especially South African English: ə-PART-(h)ayt, Afrikaans: [aˈpart(ɦ)əit] ; transl. "separateness", lit.
